messages:
rachel: customer hit a weird onboarding edge: initial quickstart echo returned OK during signup, then after adding card the same sample container started failing with 402 on /v1/completions. console showed "trial credits applied" > then flipped. anyone seen a billing state race like this?

 tom: please paste the curl + headers. 402 after a previous 200 often means either token swapped orgs or billing webhook timing.

 rachel: they ran the docker quickstart from the README. env set per README: SAMPLE_KEY=sk-temp-xxxx. sample container logs:
```
POST /v1/completions
Authorization: Bearer sk-temp-xxxx
Response: 200 OK (first request)
--- later ---
Response: 402 Payment Required
Headers: x-request-id=req_77a, x-billing-state=verification_pending, x-org=org_demo
Body: {"error":"payment_required","msg":"add payment method"}
```

 emma: couple things we've been tracking: (1) onboarding currently creates a temp trial credit record that the UI surfaces as applied while processor callback is still pending; (2) some sample quickstarts use SAMPLE_KEY env var, but our SDKs expect REDWOOD_API_KEY/REDWOOD_API_TOKEN — a mis-set env can cause a different workspace token to be used once users re-run onboarding steps. that explains some flips.

 tom: also our js-sdk v1.3.0 and python v2.0beta had a change where certain 4xx were retried by default under the generic retry policy. 402 should not be retried for non-idempotent /completions. i'll roll a patch to treat 402 as terminal (owner: tom, eta: 48h).

 rachel: workaround: customer regenerated the service account after payment cleared and restarted the container -> calls resumed. i'll add that to quickstart troubleshooting.

 onboard-bot: created INF-4975: "quickstart billing race + env var mismatch causes 402 flip" assigned tom. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4975

 emma: action items: docs - unify env var name to REDWOOD_API_KEY across all quickstarts (owner: emma, eta: today). devex - add a small preflight /v1/billing_status check in quickstarts that warns users if billing_state != active (owner: devex, eta: next week). sdk - drop retries for 402 on generate endpoints (owner: tom, eta: 48h). support - update playbook with regen+restart workaround and required headers to collect (x-request-id, x-org, timestamps).

 devex: will push a short snippet for the preflight check to the quickstart repos so support can point customers to it immediately.

 rachel: customer confirmed they followed the regen workaround and were unblocked. i'll close the support ticket after we land the docs fix. thanks all.
